notes: The top-level fields, groups, integration and totals describe the October 16 final review at 3d1a300. open lists every finding open at that review, minors included; the review table counts only blockers and majors. Groups without a branch were accepted at first review on ed62a16. Fields added to a finding after the review: resolvedAfterReview marks a finding fixed or corrected since; recordedAfterReview marks a behaviour kept and recorded as a difference since (round 3 minors); unchangedAfterReview says why a finding was left as it was. round3 holds the fix round 3, M9 and M10 lanes of October 16-17, their review outcomes, the findings those reviews raised, the prepared mobile and release branch, the gates and the totals after round 3.

Regression: form_parts records every clip path inside a touched Form once per mark rect, before any work bound, so memory grows without limit (as the product of clips and marks) up to the wasm32 4 GB heap
Pre-existing (missed in rounds 0 and 1): with many file-borne mark rects, `covered` and Regions queries are quadratic. A 67 KB file holds the worker for 74 to 89 s where engine.ts takes 0.55 s
redact-apply runs the same `shared` step first, so the unbounded clip allocation in form_parts reaches it before any apply budget
Pre-existing: the quadratic `covered` and Regions cost with many file-borne mark rects also blocks apply's gate (74 to 89 s; engine.ts 0.55 s)
Pre-existing: the pixel check walks the full area of every rect of every mark, so many large file-borne quads make apply slow (engine.ts is slower still)
The internal 'original startxref' refusal is still reachable in a 9-byte band of text after %%EOF, and app-sign.md's 'more than 1 KiB of other text' statement is inaccurate
open.resolvedAfterReview: app-p8-fix-minors (round 3 minors, merged at 034eead): the band no longer occurs on 46f1e95, the refusal is guarded and app-sign.md is corrected

foundByReview.title: The FreeText dash pattern was written unchecked; an invalid /BS /D array made an invalid d operand
A Form without a usable /BBox was decided by a box cut at the page edge, so apply removed text past the edge from a placement nobody marked (pre-existing)
Planned regions were held per clip, so page-size clips around every run refused too-large
Glyph queries were charged to no budget
The keys of shared region lists were not charged (redact-apply, from 469ccef)
The query budget was checked only between draws

recorded: Rendering grows WASM memory by about 40 KB per page-size fill; handed to integration and bounded there by the 384 MiB scene budget (e599fb3)
lanes.thirdReReview: Accepted redact-preview, redact-apply and redact-search with no new redaction finding: the uncharged keys are closed (2,000 zero-width quads apply at 60 MB of WASM at 2,000 fills); the per-glyph checks fail closed (apply works on a scratch copy); r2c refuses in 0.17-0.28 s; the 39-probe sweep is unchanged and the 18 B1 variants refuse shared-content. The render growth per fill went to integration (scene budget 384 MiB).
